reuse.why: Changes only the existing shared getRangeAmount and getExpectedAmount, which keep using getApproxNumberThreshold and are what every consumer calls.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the rule is rewritten in place in the two shared helpers.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts where the tree defines it; no caller is touched.

scope.why: Two expression changes, their comments, matching tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Math.min and amount - threshold say 'lowest value allowed' directly; only a garbled comment line ('the end of lowest value it allows') needs a touch-up.
